query:
insert or ignore into TraceMappedLinesOnlyCoveredByPassedTests (
                agg_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                file_collect_nr,
                filepath,
                file_hash,
                traced_line,
                cov_line
            )
            -- union, because tables may contain duplicate covered line entries
            select
                agg_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                file_collect_nr,
                filepath,
                file_hash,
                traced_line,
                cov_line
            from TraceMappedLinesOnlyCoveredByPassedTestRuns
            where agg_collect_nr = $1

            union

            select
                agg_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                file_collect_nr,
                filepath,
                file_hash,
                traced_line,
                cov_line
            from TraceMappedLinesOnlyCoveredByPassedTestCases
            where agg_collect_nr = $1
